verdict.rationale: Otter's pricing page lists "Otter API & Webhooks" as a plan feature, which is a first-party claim that webhooks exist. The Public API help article describes only pull-style retrieval (channels, conversations, transcripts) with no webhook registration, so the capability rests on a single thin mention. Zapier and other app integrations are not counted. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration endpoint or UI, list of subscribable event types, payload schema and signing/verification details, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Teams can automatically ingest meeting transcripts into internal knowledge bases or trigger actions based on meeting content
